planSteps.description: Navigate to the Studio workspace.
Choose the Pen tool.
Draw a short visible stroke near the center of the artwork canvas. If drawing or canvas drags are unsupported, report blocked; do not substitute rotation or timeline controls.
Select a rectangular region that surrounds that stroke using the box selection tool.
Open the Tools inspector tab.
Create a motion part from the selected artwork. Continue only when the motion panel opens successfully; otherwise report blocked.
Set the End pose horizontal translation to 4 pixels.
Set the motion frame count to 3.
Name the motion rig Wave.
Save the motion rig using its own Save motion rig button.
Cancel the active motion session. Continue only once both the PixiMotion editor and the canvas pose toolbar disappear; otherwise report blocked.
Save the project with the workspace Save button. Wait for Changes saved before proceeding.
Reload the current page.
Open the Tools inspector tab.
Open saved rig Wave.

Verify reopening actually restores the three-frame setting and End pose translation of 4 pixels, with the visible stroke preview shifted horizontally from its source position; the timeline still has one cel and no bake has occurred.

Cancel the reopened motion session. Continue only once both the PixiMotion editor and canvas pose toolbar disappear, the ordinary Tools settings return, and Open rig Wave is enabled. If that does not happen, report blocked.
Clear the previous selection using Escape while the artwork canvas is focused.
Choose the Pen tool.

Draw a new visible mark on the normal artwork canvas outside the old selection. Proceed only if the source pixels visibly change while the motion editor and pose toolbar remain absent. If drawing is unsupported, report blocked; do not click the pose toolbar, rotate controls or Bake.
Save the project. Wait for Changes saved.
Reload the current page.
Open the Tools inspector tab.
With no motion editor or pose toolbar active, click the enabled Open control for saved rig Wave once. If Open was already disabled because a motion session is active, report blocked instead.

Verify the saved rigs region shows the source-artwork-changed refusal after Open, the PixiMotion editor and pose toolbar remain absent, the new source mark remains visible, and the timeline still has one cel. A disabled Open button alone never satisfies this assertion; an active motion editor means this check failed.
